newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Q3 GDP up 1 pct yr/yr - Stat. Office.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Q3 GDP up 1 pct yr/yr - Stat. Office.

text.p: Hungary's gross domestic product (GDP) rose one percent in the third quarter of 1996 from the same period of 1995, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Friday.
However, the January-September GDP was flat over the same nine months of 1995, the KSH added.
HUNGARY GDP Q3'96 Q2'96 Q1'96 Q1-Q3'96 Q1-Q2'96
NOTE - The figures are preliminary. This was the third time that the KSH released preliminary quarterly GDP figures. It din not give absolute figures.

According to preliminary figures the GDP rose 1.5 percent in 1995 and is expected to grow by up to one percent in 1996. 1996 GDP is forecast to amount to some 6600 billion forints ($1=164.92 forints). Hungary targets two to three percent GDP growth for 1997.
